title: The planets, in order from the Sun
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Eight names in order is a good first list. It is short enough to learn in one sitting, and it opens the door to the rest of the night sky: which worlds are rocky, which are giants, and how far the Sun's family reaches.

How to hold it: Eight items is about two chunks of four, and the planets split that way on their own: four small rocky planets, then four giants. Learn the inner four, then the outer four. A first-letter sentence (a mnemonic) holds the order: My Very Eager Mouse Jumped Straight Up Nightly. Try making your own sentence, since a silly picture you made yourself sticks best.
